items.title: Greece votes this week on under-15 social media ban
items.summary: Greece's bill bars under-15s from social networks from January 2027, with platforms verifying age via privacy-preserving digital tokens. Plenary vote set for 22 October.

items.title: 40 attorneys general demand child protections in Character.AI sale
items.summary: A bipartisan coalition led by New York asks the bankruptcy court to require real age checks, harmful-content safeguards and private-data protections before any sale.

items.title: Turkey's under-15 social media ban takes effect 1 November
items.summary: Newly published law requires platforms to verify ages and bars services with an "addictive effect" for older minors, joining a widening global push.
